phases.title: Freeze provenance
phases.goal: Hash current baseline without changing it.

phases.title: Characterize evidence
phases.goal: Replay safe existing evidence and record AC gaps.

phases.title: Admission review
phases.goal: Independently accept or reject evidence completeness.

phases.title: Corrective handoff
phases.goal: Preserve fail-closed state or create a strict-TDD delta scope.

tasks.title: Freeze fair-delivery external provenance
tasks.action: Before PH-002, freeze every explicit input plus the complete local direct-and-transitive dependency closure for the five server test modules, benchmark/decision validator, frontend unit test, and static browser review roots. Resolve TypeScript AST imports through relative and @/~/ aliases including .js-to-TypeScript probing; record each local file SHA-256, Git status, and index blob. Freeze server/frontend package manifests and lockfiles, relevant TS/Vite/Playwright config, and runtime server/config.json5; external node_modules source is pinned by those manifests and lockfiles. Record raw-evidence tree count and canonical root-relative POSIX, ECMAScript UTF-16 ordinal, UTF-8 path\nsha256\n digest. Missing/unresolved local imports, missing environment input, or any inventory/closure/environment/tree mismatch rejects admission before an AC claim.

items: Manifest records every PH-002 input Git state and SHA-256 before replay.
Manifest records each resolved local closure file SHA-256, Git status, and index blob with no unresolved local import.
Manifest records package/lock/config environment inputs that pin external dependencies.
Manifest records the decision-referenced raw-evidence root file count and canonical digest.
No source or artifact is mutated.

dod: Complete PH-002 inventory, local dependency closure, execution environment, and canonical raw-evidence tree are frozen before replay.
Missing/unresolved local imports or missing/mismatched inventory, closure, environment, or tree reject admission before an AC claim.
tasks.rollback: Remove only the new admission manifest.

tasks.title: Replay server fairness and ledger evidence
tasks.action: Replay safe existing server evidence and record AC gaps without publishing artifacts only after comparing every PH-001 frozen input, complete local dependency closure, execution environment input, and decision-referenced raw-evidence tree count/canonical digest before and after replay; missing/unresolved local imports, missing environment inputs, or any mismatch reject admission before an AC claim.

acceptance_tests.threshold: artifact threshold, tolerance, raw-trial and starvation gate must all exist

dod: AC-1..AC-8 are evidenced or unsatisfied only after complete input inventory, dependency closure, execution environment, and raw-evidence tree match.
tasks.rollback: Keep candidate admission closed and legacy fallback unchanged.

tdd.exempt_reason: This perf replay only observes existing baseline behavior and changes no implementation or test semantics.

tasks.title: Characterize browser ACK and idle boundary
tasks.action: Statically characterize ACK, idle, and hidden-recovery boundaries.

items: Hidden recovery is an explicit gap.

dod: AC-5..AC-9 has evidence or explicit gap.
No Playwright or browser behavior change occurs.
tasks.rollback: Leave browser capability and delivery behavior unchanged.

tasks.title: Independently review provenance and gaps
tasks.action: Independently review AC matrix, evidence, boundaries, and corrective need.

items: Every AC is evidenced or unsatisfied.

dod: Rejection names the minimum strict-TDD delta.
tasks.rollback: Preserve PERF in_progress and candidate admission closed.

tasks.title: Record admission result or strict-TDD handoff
tasks.action: Only when independent evidence satisfies AC-1..AC-9 and independent review returns No findings may guarded lifecycle run in exact order: add_verification_evidence per AC, then check_acceptance_criteria, then update_status(implemented). Completed-work and verified are prohibited until every prior step succeeds; rejection retains PERF in_progress and creates strict-TDD handoff.

items: Promotion requires independent AC-1..AC-9 evidence and No findings.
Lifecycle order is per-AC add_verification_evidence, then check_acceptance_criteria, then update_status(implemented).
Completed-work and verified are prohibited until every prior step succeeds.
Rejected admission remains in_progress with no lifecycle promotion.
Any behavior delta begins with a genuine RED test.

dod: Outcome is evidence-based and fail-closed with evidence, AC-check, implemented order.
No completed-work or verified promotion occurs before lifecycle success.
tasks.rollback: Do not mutate SRS lifecycle when admission is rejected.

risks.description: Hidden or split gaps may be mistaken for evidence.
